notes.title: Patch Notes 17.0.6a
notes.content:
Gooooood day Dreamers!!

Here is a fresh batch of added, improved and fixed features and elements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8bfdb3e343c206075ac910073056ad0c28868fff.png

NEW

A new playable story transition has been added, the Descent! This happens before Amber arrives at the hub after her long slumber.

When coming from this transition, Amber will appear further up in the Overworld.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/d7af57884078ea1c65855d82cdda7dd38f82a619.png

All Hall of Portals sections now have 10 levels (except for Featured, which keeps 7).
Internal restructuring to the game flow to better accommodate the new playable sequence and future developments.
Leaderboards now scale the name of long levels instead of cutting it off.
The Garden's features will all be progressively integrated into the rest of the game instead of being their own separate thing.
Atelier: the center grid-lines are bolder, and the whole grid now expands to 1000x1000.
Exit key arrows now appear behind the game timer.
Improved the thumbnail for the level Debris.
Light Blocks, Crystals and Pendant Lamps can now be colored.

Atelier: fixed returning to the editor after level submission.
Atelier & Adventure: fixed a few endless loops due to the new navigation system.

notes.content:
Dreamers!!

TODAY IS THE BIG DAY.

Amberial Dreams has now launched to Steam on PC for 6.99 USD/EUR.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png

DISCOVER OUR LAUNCH TRAILER

If you are discovering Amberial Dreams today, welcome, you are now a Dreamer! And a Roller, too.
You are about to enter a cosmic precision platformer packed with rhythmic contraptions, arcade platforming and colourful worlds!
We hope you will love being with us, in our world filled with wonders and wicked levels.

[previewyoutube=AP4zdHkSgc8;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png

WHAT'S AMBERIAL DREAMS YOU SAY?

SIMPLE YET SKILLED

Amberial Dreams is a simple yet challenging precision platformer set in a dream-like evolving world. Roll left and right, using your momentum and terrain features to bounce through deadly traps, pixel perfect jumps or atmospheric levels. 
Explore the story at your own pace, compete on online leaderboards, or create and share your own levels!
Join us in rediscovering the Amberial hit series after four flash titles.

RESTORE THE BALANCE, ONE WORLD AT A TIME

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/491f6ba5a663dfbfaf84caeef58321651dc6c0fc.png
Throughout the campaign, you will embody the avatar of Amber, one of the Dreamers, shapers of this universe. 
The other Dreamers have disappeared leaving you alone against a growing corruption. 
Witness the sinister changes that have occurred during your long slumber and find a way to restore balance, one world at a time.
Roll through an even greater challenge in the Spire of Trials. A collection of infamous and wicked levels, putting even veterans to the test.

ONE OF THE BEST LEVEL EDITORS

Amberial  Dreams  features  one  of  the  most  complete level editor tools in the platformer genre. Everything is usable by the community up to the levels themselves.

A powerful level editor allowing players to modify each campaign level or create their own.
An advanced curation system to find the best levels quickly through  tags, endorsement and notes.
Dozens of unique community levels already available, and many more to come.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8435a573e1a1b9b0398983dc9cfe9680087f6f82.jpg
LEVEL EDITOR TIPS & TRICKS

Play with levels you already beat.
You can use the template of any level you have beaten. Explore the possibilities!
Have fun with the physical properties!
A lot of elements have different properties, modifying how they work. You can always move them to the foreground or background to add extra spice!
A GAME WE WANT TO BUILD WITH YOU

Based on its four predecessors and the feedbacks of two million players, Amberial Dreams keeps the same dynamic. 
Throughout the Early Access, we will release regular patches and major content updates with gameplay elements, levels, quality of life improvements as well as new tools for the community.
We want the players to be part of what defines the game, and of the priorities of our updates thanks to their feedback and comments! Join our official Amberial Dreams Discord Server to ask questions, provide feedback, suggest new features and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png

STARTING TIPS
To get the ball rolling! (Yep, I just did that.)

CONTROL YOUR MOMENTUM
On the ground or even mid-air, you can modify your speed and trajectory. The faster you will roll, the less accurate you will be, but the farther you will go.

USE THE TERRAIN TO YOUR ADVANTAGE
Knowing how to use the terrain, elements and contraptions around to speed you up, slow you down or make you jump to your destination will make everything easier.

THINK OUTSIDE THE BOX
The obvious way might not be the best one. Many levels offer shortcuts for those who dare!

TAKE A BREAK
Harder levels can be frustrating at first, give it some time! Be kind to yourself, take a break, sip some tea or coffee and get back to it once you're ready to crack your knuckles and tackle the challenge at hand. 
Also, you don’t need to beat every level to progress through the campaign. You might learn some helpful tricks down the line!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How long is the Early Access going to last? When is the full release planned?

The Early Access is planned to last one year and the game should release Q4 2023.

The game is priced at 6.99$/€ in EA. It will become 9.99$/€ for the full launch.

You can get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/917140/Amberial_Dreams/

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Why an Early Access?

Whilst the game is fully playable, we want to use to use the community feedback to keep improving it and add content. It is paramount for us to  grow our world together with the players.

At the start of Early Access, the game will have 4 worlds and 50 levels.

notes.title: August 2019 Update
notes.content:
After much testing and thinking, the game is now on the final track to finalising most of the important design decisions, clearing the way for easier progress.

These were questions such as:

 How to best organize the menus and user flows?
 What happens when a player gets eliminated in co-op multiplayer?
 How much of the level backgrounds should we prepopulate?
 How should the camera react to the level bounds?
 etc. etc. etc.!


In September I will be making the roadmap public. One of my main goals is being more communicative and open about the whole development process.

Here is some of the progress of the month:

 Finished upgrading to a new lighting and background system:
https://media.giphy.com/media/Y1545J7rHcluaaQsUA/giphy.gif

 Implemented import / export functions to the level editor

 Added an initial options screen, and made progress on the control system

 Many little graphical improvements 

 Almost finished with the camera systems, including zooming, staying within dynamic bounds, and showing the level bounds in the editor


Thanks everyone who wishlisted and is following this!


- Cuauhtemoc "oddgoo" Moreno
